newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour says government defeat now more likely.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour says government defeat now more likely.

text.p: The Labour party's home affairs spokesman, Jack Straw, on Wednesday attacked the government's new legislative programme as "threadbare" and said it would make a defeat of the ruling Conservatives even more likely.
"It makes the defeat of this miserable government even more likely than it's been before," Straw told a BBC interviewer.

"The public will see that it's a threadbare, partisan speech which has virtually no proposals for dealing with what everyone now recognises is a fractured society, a society which is deeply uneasy about what has happened over the last decade and a half.

"It is a Queen's speech for the few against the many and I think the British public will say enough is enough and that the election date cannot come soon enough," he said. -- London newsroom 0171 542 7767
